parsed.notes:
Requirements section is 'What should you bring along?'. It has no optional heading, so unmarked items are required.
Fuzzing, penetration testing, vulnerability detection, open-source AI models and user interfaces appear only in the responsibilities, so they are not labeled.
'Automotive Cybersecurity' could be read as domain knowledge. It is mapped to the cybersecurity taxonomy entry and flagged uncertain.
'agentic AI toolchains' is mapped to agents. Its alias list includes agentic AI frameworks.
'commercial and open-source technologies' does not name LLMs explicitly, so open-source-llms is not labeled.
'complex security toolchains' has no specific taxonomy entry. It is listed as unmapped and is arguably already covered by cybersecurity.
Seniority: 'Several years' is read as roughly 3–5 years, giving mid (inferred). This is uncertain because 'several' could also mean 5+.
German: 'desirable' is treated as an optional marker, so German is nice_to_have.
Degree: 'or a comparable qualification' matches the guide's 'or comparable qualification' wording, so degree_or_equivalent is true. It could instead be read as widening the field, so it is flagged.
There are no alternative groups.
